Connectivity_Statistics.label: Connectivity Statistics
Connectivity_Statistics.description: This LwM2M Objects enables client to collect statistical information and enables the LwM2M Server to retrieve these information, set the collection duration and reset the statistical parameters.

SMS_Tx_Counter.label: SMS Tx Counter
SMS_Tx_Counter.description: Indicate the total number of SMS successfully transmitted during the collection period.

SMS_Rx_Counter.label: SMS Rx Counter
SMS_Rx_Counter.description: Indicate the total number of SMS successfully received during the collection period.

Tx_Data.label: Tx Data
Tx_Data.description: Indicate the total amount of data (IP / non-IP) transmitted during the collection period expressed in kilobytes.

Rx_Data.label: Rx Data
Rx_Data.description: Indicate the total amount of data (IP / non-IP) received during the collection period expressed in kilobytes.

Max_Message_Size.label: Max Message Size
Max_Message_Size.description: The maximum IP message size that is used during the collection period.

Average_Message_Size.label: Average Message Size
Average_Message_Size.description: The average IP message size that is used during the collection period.

Collection_Period.label: Collection Period
Collection_Period.description: The default collection period in seconds. The value 0 indicates that the collection period is not set.

Start.label: Start
Start.description:
Reset resources 0-5 to 0 and start to collect information, If resource 8 (Collection Period) value is 0, the client will keep collecting information until resource 7 (Stop) is executed, otherwise the client will stop collecting information after specified period ended.
        Note:When reporting the Tx Data or Rx Data, the LwM2M Client reports the total KB transmitted/received over IP bearer(s), including all protocol header bytes up to and including the IP header. This does not include lower level retransmissions/optimizations (e.g. RAN, header compression) or SMS messages.

Stop.label: Stop
Stop.description: Stop collecting information, but do not reset resources 0-5.
